passages.title: Restaurant Guide
passages.text:
A) The Green Leaf: A perfect spot for vegans, offering a wide range of plant-based dishes. It is open for breakfast and lunch. 
B) Pasta Palace: Famous for its homemade Italian noodles. It is open late every night and is very popular with students. 
C) Burger Haven: A casual place known for its quick service and large portions. Great for people who want a fast meal before a movie. 
D) Sushi Station: A quiet, high-end restaurant that serves fresh fish. It requires a reservation and is quite expensive. 
E) Spice Garden: Offers a variety of spicy curries from around the world. It has a large outdoor area which is great for warm evenings. 
F) The Daily Bread: A cozy bakery and cafe that serves fresh sandwiches and coffee all day. It is very affordable. 
G) Ocean View: Located right on the beach, this place is famous for its seafood and beautiful sunset views. 
H) Taco Time: A lively, colorful restaurant that serves authentic street food. It is perfect for large groups of friends.

questions.question: Sarah wants to eat somewhere cheap where she can grab a quick sandwich and a coffee during the day.
questions.explanation: The Daily Bread is described as a cozy bakery and cafe serving sandwiches and coffee, and it is affordable.

questions.question: Mark is a vegan and is looking for a place that serves breakfast.
questions.explanation: The Green Leaf is specifically mentioned as a perfect spot for vegans and is open for breakfast.

questions.question: Elena is celebrating her birthday with ten friends and wants a fun, lively atmosphere.
questions.explanation: Taco Time is described as a lively, colorful restaurant perfect for large groups of friends.

questions.question: David wants to eat a nice meal outside while the weather is warm.
questions.explanation: Spice Garden has a large outdoor area which is specifically recommended for warm evenings.

questions.question: Tom is a student who finishes his classes late and needs a place to eat dinner.
questions.explanation: Pasta Palace is open late every night and is popular with students.
